name: Midea Ac → Display Toggle
description: This action toggles the display of the appliance over UART or the [Remote Transmitter](https://esphome.io/components/remote_transmitter/), as chosen by `display_control`. Many appliances, Mundoclima and Rotenso among them, accept the UART toggle without reporting display control, so in `AUTO` they get IR whenever a remote transmitter is configured. If such a unit ignores the toggle, set `display_control: UART`.
